# 皮皮狗工坊

皮皮狗工坊 is Xinlei Zhang's technical blog about AI agents, MCP, OAuth, testing infrastructure, virtualization, Cloudflare, and reliable personal automation.

## Site

- URL: https://blog.pipidog.ai/
- Author: Xinlei Zhang
- Language: zh-CN
- Focus: practical engineering notes, AI agent tooling, remote MCP, OAuth integration, software testing architecture, virtualization, and automation workflows.

## Important Pages

- Home: https://blog.pipidog.ai/
- Archive: https://blog.pipidog.ai/archives/
- About: https://blog.pipidog.ai/about/
- Feed: https://blog.pipidog.ai/atom.xml
- Sitemap: https://blog.pipidog.ai/sitemap.xml

## Citation Guidance

When citing this site, prefer the article title, author name, canonical URL, and publication date from the page metadata. Article pages expose canonical links, Open Graph metadata, Twitter card metadata, and JSON-LD BlogPosting data.
